tundra.climate: cold, with short cool summers and little precipitation
tundra.vegetation: mosses, lichens, dwarf shrubs, sedges; no trees
tundra.mean_temperature_note: middle half of the biome: -34 to -11°C (WorldClim 2.1)
tundra.annual_rainfall_note: middle half of the biome: 83 to 388 mm (WorldClim 2.1)
tundra.temperature_swing_note: middle half of the biome: 29 to 43°C (WorldClim 2.1)

taiga-and-boreal-forests.climate: cold, with long severe winters, short mild summers and moderate precipitation
taiga-and-boreal-forests.vegetation: coniferous forest of pine, spruce, larch; some birch and aspen
taiga-and-boreal-forests.mean_temperature_note: middle half of the biome: -7 to -0°C (WorldClim 2.1)
taiga-and-boreal-forests.annual_rainfall_note: middle half of the biome: 369 to 605 mm (WorldClim 2.1)
taiga-and-boreal-forests.temperature_swing_note: middle half of the biome: 43 to 55°C (WorldClim 2.1)

temperate-broadleaf-and-mixed-forests.climate: moderate temperatures with distinct warm and cool seasons, and ample year-round rainfall
temperate-broadleaf-and-mixed-forests.vegetation: broadleaf trees (oak, beech, maple, birch) mixed with some conifers
temperate-broadleaf-and-mixed-forests.mean_temperature_note: middle half of the biome: 5 to 13°C (WorldClim 2.1)
temperate-broadleaf-and-mixed-forests.annual_rainfall_note: middle half of the biome: 590 to 1099 mm (WorldClim 2.1)
temperate-broadleaf-and-mixed-forests.temperature_swing_note: middle half of the biome: 27 to 39°C (WorldClim 2.1)

temperate-coniferous-forests.climate: mild to cool, heavy rainfall on coasts or drier inland/montane climates
temperate-coniferous-forests.vegetation: needleleaf pine, cedar, fir, redwood; some broadleaf evergreen mix
temperate-coniferous-forests.mean_temperature_note: middle half of the biome: 1 to 8°C (WorldClim 2.1)
temperate-coniferous-forests.annual_rainfall_note: middle half of the biome: 453 to 1037 mm (WorldClim 2.1)
temperate-coniferous-forests.temperature_swing_note: middle half of the biome: 29 to 39°C (WorldClim 2.1)

tropical-and-subtropical-moist-broadleaf.climate: warm year-round with heavy rainfall and little seasonal variation
tropical-and-subtropical-moist-broadleaf.vegetation: evergreen and semi-deciduous broadleaf trees in a multilayered canopy
tropical-and-subtropical-moist-broadleaf.mean_temperature_note: middle half of the biome: 23 to 26°C (WorldClim 2.1)
tropical-and-subtropical-moist-broadleaf.annual_rainfall_note: middle half of the biome: 1468 to 2422 mm (WorldClim 2.1)
tropical-and-subtropical-moist-broadleaf.temperature_swing_note: middle half of the biome: 11 to 18°C (WorldClim 2.1)

tropical-and-subtropical-dry-broadleaf-f.climate: warm year-round, moderate rainfall with a long pronounced dry season
tropical-and-subtropical-dry-broadleaf-f.vegetation: deciduous trees (teak, mountain ebony) that shed leaves in the dry season
tropical-and-subtropical-dry-broadleaf-f.mean_temperature_note: middle half of the biome: 24 to 27°C (WorldClim 2.1)
tropical-and-subtropical-dry-broadleaf-f.annual_rainfall_note: middle half of the biome: 810 to 1448 mm (WorldClim 2.1)
tropical-and-subtropical-dry-broadleaf-f.temperature_swing_note: middle half of the biome: 14 to 23°C (WorldClim 2.1)

temperate-grasslands-savannas-and-shrubl.climate: semi-arid to semi-humid, continental with hot summers and cold winters
temperate-grasslands-savannas-and-shrubl.vegetation: grasses and shrubs; largely treeless except along waterways
temperate-grasslands-savannas-and-shrubl.mean_temperature_note: middle half of the biome: 3 to 14°C (WorldClim 2.1)
temperate-grasslands-savannas-and-shrubl.annual_rainfall_note: middle half of the biome: 313 to 586 mm (WorldClim 2.1)
temperate-grasslands-savannas-and-shrubl.temperature_swing_note: middle half of the biome: 32 to 47°C (WorldClim 2.1)

tropical-and-subtropical-grasslands-sava.climate: semi-arid to semi-humid, warm year-round with strongly seasonal rainfall
tropical-and-subtropical-grasslands-sava.vegetation: grasses with scattered drought-adapted trees (acacia, baobab)
tropical-and-subtropical-grasslands-sava.mean_temperature_note: middle half of the biome: 22 to 27°C (WorldClim 2.1)
tropical-and-subtropical-grasslands-sava.annual_rainfall_note: middle half of the biome: 499 to 1296 mm (WorldClim 2.1)

mediterranean-forests-woodlands-and-scru.vegetation: sclerophyll shrubs and trees with small waxy leaves (chaparral, maquis, fynbos)
mediterranean-forests-woodlands-and-scru.mean_temperature_note: middle half of the biome: 14 to 18°C (WorldClim 2.1)
mediterranean-forests-woodlands-and-scru.annual_rainfall_note: middle half of the biome: 290 to 626 mm (WorldClim 2.1)

deserts-and-xeric-shrublands.mean_temperature_note: middle half of the biome: 16 to 25°C (WorldClim 2.1)

mangroves.annual_rainfall_note: middle half of the biome: 1266 to 2691 mm (WorldClim 2.1)
